spec.name: enforcement-scope-stated
spec.intent:
Census @15d0a621 (main; plan/guided-install and plan/purview-routes, both unreleased, leave this entry's lines untouched); re-derive any line cited below if its path changed since.
Realize in the user-facing statement of `enforcement scope` the three clauses amended 2026-09-30T21:21: a guard judges an act against the contract of the agent that performs it; a refused act stays refused however often it is retried, a retry judged again and never waved through; and a guard hands its judge only the test in a few sentences and the act and contract it applies to.
AT CENSUS. The Enforcement scope entry of packages/cli/README.md (L102-120) says whom a guard binds, that it skips a subagent (and how on Claude Code), how a persona is enrolled, what a harness that cannot name the agent does, that a guard whose judge cannot run says so and asks again, and that a judgement fits its harness's time with `the judge is sent a rubric cut to what it needs to decide` (L118). It says nothing of whose contract an act is judged against, of a retried act, or of what the judge is handed beyond that rubric sentence.
CHANGE. In that entry, say that a guard judges an act against the contract of the agent that performs it, and that on omp a session the module cannot tell to be the persona's main session is not judged and the guard says so (unit omp-guard-precise); that a refused act stays refused, its retry judged again, with no cap that lets it through (units purview-guard-precise, pre-call-refusal-holds and stance-guard-precise); and that the judge is handed the test in a few sentences with the act and the contract, and nothing else, replacing the `rubric cut` sentence. Plain prose in the entry's register; change no other entry.
accept: Printed, the Enforcement scope entry of packages/cli/README.md (from `- **Enforcement scope.**` to the next `- **` entry) states the three clauses: the performing agent's contract, a retry judged again and never waved through, and the judge handed only its test with the act and the contract; and `grep -c 'rubric cut' packages/cli/README.md` prints 0. At 15d0a621 the entry states none of the three and the grep prints 1.
`git diff --name-only <the unit's base> <landed commit>` prints only packages/cli/README.md (records/ excepted).
